name: Bon Bon's Sweets & More
description: Pickup-only cake pop shop with Supabase ordering and Gmail notifications.

NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.description: HTTPS origin of the deployed website, without a trailing slash.

BONBONS_INTERNAL_API_TOKEN.description: Private token matching the existing bonbons-data Edge Function.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: A strong, unique production admin password (at least 16 characters).

GMAIL_USER.description: Google mailbox used for customer emails.

NEXT_PUBLIC_RECAPTCHA_ENTERPRISE_SITE_KE.description: Public Enterprise checkbox site key; allow the deployed hostname in Google Cloud.

GOOGLE_RECAPTCHA_API_KEY.description: Server-only key permitted to create reCAPTCHA assessments.
